resources.string: Now: nothing is old enough yet.

After that, Recap checks once a day and removes the audio of meetings as they pass %1$d days. A quiet notification says when it has removed something.\n\nRemoved audio can\'t be recovered. Those meetings can no longer be played or followed along, shared as audio or clips, checked for accuracy, used to learn a voice, or transcribed again.

After that, Recap checks once a day and deletes meetings as they pass %1$d days. A quiet notification says when it has deleted something. Deleted meetings can be restored from Recently deleted for 30 days; after that they\'re erased for good.
They can be restored from Recently deleted for 30 days; after that they\'re erased for good.
